text: Since 2019, the difference in PPG from a top-8 pick to picks 9-12 in the first round is only 0.5 in PPR (if your guy is going 9th on average and you have pick 5, just go get your guy)
The only starting QB since 2024 with 0 carries from inside the 2-yard line is Lamar Jackson.
After leading the NFL in deep targets with 32, DK Metcalf dropped down to 17 in 2025 with Aaron Rodgers despite a heavily vertical route tree.
In his third straight season with his fantasy PPG decreasing, Travis Kelce ranked 28th among TE in red zone target share.
Minnesota and their WRs sucked last year. Yet still, Kevin O'Connell's offenses rank 5th in receiving PPG in his four seasons with the Vikings.
In Travis Hunter's four games with 20+ defensive snaps, he averaged 5.8 PPG (13.5 PPG & 2x more tgts in other 3 games).
Puka Nacua's targets per route since 2024 is 36.8%. No other qualified player is over 30%.

Dalton Kincaid ranked 1st among TE in tgts/route, yds/route, yds/tgt, yds/rec, 1st downs/route, targeted passer rating, yds/tgt over expected, fantasy pts/route, & expected fantasy pts/route in 2025. Efficiency is not the problem; he just needs more routes (<25% of run-blocking snaps).
Denver's offense (14th in scoring) ranked 7th in WR fantasy points, despite a much weaker WR room compared to other top-10 teams. (Waddle bump)
The top-3 QBs in checkdown % were all CIN QBs in 2025 (yay Chase Brown)
Since entering the NFL, CMC has 4 of the 5 best PPR seasons in fantasy football (Barkley 2018). Unparalleled ceiling.
Malik Willis is 5th in fantasy pts/snap among QBs since 2023 and 1st in 2025.
In Jacksonville's final four games, Parker Washington had 454 rec yards. Thomas & Meyers combined for 267, despite both having more routes than Washington.
Trey McBride had 667 routes in 2025. Ja'Marr Chase was 2nd with 613, Travis Kelce 2nd among TE with 511.
Tyler Warren's tgt/route skyrocketed from 21% with Michael Pittman on the field to 30% without. For comparison, McBride's tgt/route in 2025 was 24.4%
CMC was the only RB above 2.0 combined goal line carries + red zone targets. But in 2024, both Kareem Hunt & Chuba Hubbard were above 2.0 as well (great for KW3 & Hubbard’s potential)
The highest catch rate on deep balls in 2025: 1. Kayshon Boutte 2. Stefon Diggs 3. Jaxon Smith-Njigba 4. Puka Nacua (Drake Maye WRs)
Rome Odunze had 55% of his end zone targets deemed 'inaccurate'. The next closest was 37. DJ Moore also vacated 13 end zone targets, 4th most among WRs.
Luther Burden ranked 8th in fantasy points per snap as a rookie. 6 of the 7 WRs above him were fantasy WR1s.

Travis Etienne was 35th in explosive carry %, but 14th in explosive yards (biggest diff in RB). His explosive points far outweighed his per att production. He also was the only RB with multiple explosive receiving TDs (3, 1 prior in career).
Flowers 4.83 yds/route on play action was the 2nd-best among WR. Play action %: BAL 26th, CHI (new OC) 2nd
In his last 17 games with Joe Burrow, Ja'Marr Chase has exactly 200 targets (Amon-Ra was 2nd to Chase in targets in 2025 with 172 in 17 games).
In total RB volume (expected fantasy points), SF, DET, & ATL were unsurprisingly top-3. 4th was the Steelers, with multiple RBs in the top-24 in volume.
Tetairoa McMillan had 16 targets dropped/or a WR error in his rookie season (T-most in NFL w/ BTJ, I'd expect this to bounce back in a major way in Year 2)
Justin Jefferson has failed to hit his season average in fantasy points in all 6 fantasy championships (avg: 10.6 PPG).
Kyler Murray only played 5 games in 2025, but was the fantasy QB5 (PPG) from 2019-2024, & a QB1 in all 6 seasons. Kevin O'Connell's QBs have finished QB12, QB6, QB9, QB30 in MIN.
Kyle Pitts was the TE5 last season, but the distance in PPG to the TE4 is the same as the distance to TE15.
Liam Coen's QB ranks 3rd in fantasy PPG since 2024 (Allen, Jackson) and 4th in passing PPG (Burrow, Goff, Stafford).
Jalen Hurts will have his 5th playcaller in 5 years in 2026. All 4 previous playcallers have given the QB over 40% of the team's goal-line carries. (Sirianni's gonna tush)
Trevor Lawrence and Jared Goff, former No. 1 overall picks went from bottom-4 QBs as rookies to QB11 in Year 2. Cam Ward finished as the QB32 in 2025 w/ the league's hardest fantasy QB schedule.
In the last 10 years, only 2/33 RBs in the first 4 rounds to score 20+ PPG came in Rounds 3-4, while 7/30 WRs to score 20+ PPG did.

DeVonta Smith, Luther Burden, & Ladd McConkey, all WRs who played a lot in the slot in 2025, were all much better in yards/route outside, contrary to popular belief. All 3 will play more outside in 2026 (yds/rt bump: Smith +150%, Burden +59%, McConkey +39%)
Davante Adams 7.9 PPG on end zone targets in 2025 was the most since 2007 Randy Moss. In 2008, Moss dipped down to 3.1
Of top-12 drafted RBs in the NFL Draft in recent history, only CMC and Bijan did not score 15+ PPG as rookies before Jeanty failed to as well. In year 2, Bijan was RB3 overall, CMC RB2 overall.*
Lamar Jackson had 5 TDs dropped in 2025, the most in the NFL, even though he was last in pass att/gm and only played 13 games (does not count the I. Likely endzone fmbl)
Emeka Egbuka was the only WR to play a top-5 fantasy WR defense 5 times, without playing a single bottom-5 WR defense. (TB: hardest WR schedule of 2025)
Jahmyr Gibbs was 2nd in yds/att in gap schemes, and 42nd in zone schemes last season. James Conner led the NFL in gap schemes (69%) in 2024 w/ D. Petzing as OC.
Jadarian Price had a PFF pass blocking grade of 38.5 in his college career (bad). The bottom 3 RBs in pass blocking grade from 2025 were rookies.
KC & Andy Reid ranked 5th in RB PPG from 2014-2023 (29th in the last two seasons).
When taking just Chase Brown's starts in 2024, Zac Taylor has produced a fantasy RB1 in Each of his last 6 seasons as Cincinnati's head coach.
Josh McDaniels has been OC/HC for 19 years. His RB1 has hit 60% of the team RB touches only 5 times, with only 3 RBs crossing 15+ PPR PPG (2022 LV Jacobs, 2012 STL Jackson, 2010 DEN Moreno).
De'Von Achane averages 11.4 receiving PPG w/ Tua Tagovailoa in his career. In his 8 games without, that drops to 3.4
Jaylen Warren was top-2 among RB in targets/route, yards/route, and missed tackles/reception in 2025. PIT has the most vacated RB targets with 82.
35 'passing' QBs have been drafted in Rounds 2-5 since 2015, with a hit rate of 31%... rushing QBs are at 63%, while Josh Allen is at 100%.
Josh Allen has finished top-2 in fantasy points among QBs in each of the last 6 seasons nobody else has finished top-2 twice.
Ladd McConkey's yards per route increase by 96% with motion. Mike McDaniel runs the most motion in the NFL.
In my luck metric stat, CeeDee Lamb was the unluckiest player of 2025, with -2.7 PPG from his 'bad luck'.
Drake Maye was the QB32 in 4th quarters last season, and QB1 from quarters 1-3. The Patriots schedule now makes them the favorites in only 10 games.
Brian Thomas Jr's first 8 week CB schedule: D. Ward, P. Surtain, C. Gonzalez, D. Turner, Q. Mitchell, D. Stingley, BYE, S. Gardner

14 RBs have been selected top-25 in the NFL Draft since 2015. Of the first 11 RBs in the group, ALL 11 had an RB1 fantasy season by their second year. Jeanty & Hampton can make it 13/13 in their sophomore year with an RB1 season (+J. Love).
